purpose: INT-201/INT-202 dry-run plan rehearsal against the current source baseline

baseline.reason: the v5.37 product-line feature added product_line_workspaces and product_component_sources to the Aims source

conflictResolutions.finding: the two reserved ~line- unified product-line spaces have no Assets master by design; the rule treated them as orphans
conflictResolutions.resolution: rule tightened, not relaxed: a ~line- workspace is now a conflict only when product_line_workspaces has no matching row; sources predating v5.37 keep the original rule

conflictResolutions.finding: value-only JSON columns carrying no internal auto-increment id had no executable validation
conflictResolutions.resolution: registered with per-family validators in value_json_contract.go (string lists, frozen scoring-model versions, catalog page receipt shape); registration keeps rejecting unknown versions, and value-only families no longer inherit the Aims planning dependency list

conflictResolutions.finding: the version contract reports every unrecognised receipt/audit carrying JSON (fail closed); the product workspace onboarding family (products:onboard, products:edit, products:onboard-line) had never been registered
conflictResolutions.resolution: new workspace_onboard_json_contract.go validates the family against the workspace row, the reserved ~line- namespace and product_line_workspaces; the version contract now defers those actions instead of judging them

conflictResolutions.finding: the mutation rule judged every edit/transition audit, including workspace edits that belong to the onboarding family
onboard-line audit history exists in two frozen shapes across the product-selection change: the older row carries reason and no selected list
conflictResolutions.resolution: the contract accepts both frozen shapes; audit history is never rewritten

safety: Dry-run only. Source remains the sole writer, target generation stays 0, and no runtime route, credential or business row was changed.
